page.content:
First U.S. human spaceflight program — one astronaut, one orbit at a time.

How Project Mercury connects

  • Topic: NASA — Project Mercury was NASA's first crewed spaceflight program.
  • Faction: Project Gemini — Gemini followed Mercury as NASA's second crewed program.
  • Character: Katherine Johnson — Katherine Johnson's trajectories backed Mercury orbital flights.
  • Location: Cape Canaveral — Mercury crewed flights launched from Cape Canaveral pads.

What is Project Mercury?

Project Mercury (1958–63) put Alan Shepard and then John Glenn into space and proved that NASA could launch, track, and recover a crewed capsule.

Key threads lead to NASA, Project Gemini, Katherine Johnson and Cape Canaveral.
